Elena Markov: Quick sync: FluxWorks asked for a focused bench to validate perf/W claims for marketplace listing. Scope: redwood-2b, profiling of kernel flag stacks, and a short thermal drift run. Need owners for run matrix, telemetry mapping, and marketplace copy.
Samir Vyas: I can own the run matrix. Proposal: 4 variants (baseline, tokopt, int8, combined) x QPS [30,60,120] x 2 repeats. Warmup 180s.
Tom Greer: I'll handle telemetry. Ask FluxWorks to provide PDU CSV and dmesg/kernel logs. We'll require NTP sync and a signed sha256 of uploads. I can write a tiny parser that maps PDU outlet -> node serial.
Elena Markov: Acceptance criteria: tokens/W within 15% of our baseline; p95 latency within +8% at target QPS; no degradation on adversarial prompts. If any run shows thermal drift, capture the 20min trace.
Samir Vyas: Run command to give partner:
```bash
./flux_bench --model redwood-2b --qps 60 --batch 12 --variant combined --warmup 180 --duration 300 --out ./flux_results.json
```
Output: tokens_total,tokens_per_sec,avg_power_w,p50_ms,p95_ms,kernel_flags,run_tag.
Tom Greer: I'll add board_temp_c and fan_rpm if available. Also promote use of our reproducible kernel container image.
infra-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-9001 and provisioning bucket s3://redwood-partner-ingest/fluxworks/ with write policy limited to partner-upload role.
Elena Markov: Timeline: today - matrix + telemetry spec; Mon - bucket + access; Tue - PR with runbook and report template; Wed - partner runs; Thu - ingest + draft report.
Samir Vyas: Repo redwood/fluxworks-bench created, PR incoming with flag list and run_all.sh.
Tom Greer: Parser PR open, supports ISO8601 and epoch ms timestamps and validates CRCs.
bench-bot: Reminder set for results ingest at 1796001156.
Elena Markov: Great. Action items: Samir matrix + scripts; Tom telemetry shims; I'll draft marketplace copy after ingest. Ping when done.
